sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side rooted to the foot of the league on just 4 points with a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, with Stafford also coming off a recent loss and keen to maintain close contact with Sandbach at the summit. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, travel to Eccleshall in what could be a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community at home; Casuals are in form with three consecutive wins prior to this matchday. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a clash between sides occupying sixth and thirteenth respectively. Crewe's visit to face Allscott Heath and Market Drayton's home game against New Mills pit mid-to-lower table sides seeking to climb away from danger. Brereton Social host Widnes Town in a contest between teams with just 9 points separating them in the table, with Widnes notably bottom and winless; Brereton then have a midweek home fixture against Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October. Shawbury United's home match against Barnton sees hosts Shawbury on an alarming run of six consecutive losses, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in what is a fixture between two of the league's poorest-performing teams.
